entities.name: Harbourside Sailing Club Incorporated
entities.about: A volunteer-run sailing club on Nelson's waterfront: 124 members, junior learn-to-sail, a clubroom bar, one regatta a year, and a grant this year to renew the training fleet.

exampleAiSuggestions.because: Paint and varnish from a hardware store: most likely for the boats or the clubroom.
Printed programmes are part of putting on the regatta.
exampleAiSuggestions.caution: Printing and stationery would do as well; keep it with the regatta if you report on it.

exampleAiSuggestions.because: Money in from a local business, with a programme advert as the reference.
exampleAiSuggestions.caution: An advert is sponsorship, not a gift: something was given in return. A Sponsorship account would be better.

grants.purpose: Replace two worn training dinghies and fit them out
grants.conditions: To be spent on the training fleet. A report with receipts is due once it is spent; any unspent money is returned.
